description:
## Symptom

After submitting a prompt, the second line of the welcome banner hints (` ctrl+o more`) gets corrupted mid-stream to read ` ctrl+o morerrupt · ctrl+c/ctrl+d clear/exit · / commands · ! bash ·`. The fragment `rrupt · ctrl+c...` is the tail of `interrupt` from the line above — consistent with the terminal cursor being positioned on line 2 while a write intended for line 1 overflows into it.

Reproducible on every prompt submission, visible before the first streaming token arrives.

---

## Root Cause

**File**: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/renderer.ex`, **line 329**

`previous_viewport_top` is computed from `render_end` instead of `hw_row` (the actual hardware cursor position after `position_cursor` runs):

```elixir
# CURRENT (wrong):
new_vp_top = max(prev_vp_top, render_end - height + 1)

# CORRECT:
new_vp_top = max(prev_vp_top, hw_row - height + 1)
```

`position_cursor/3`[^1] can set `hw_row` to a value different from `render_end` when a `cursor_seq` containing `\e[row;colH` is present. After that call, `hardware_cursor_row` is stored as `hw_row`[^2], but `previous_viewport_top` is anchored to `render_end`[^3] — the two state values become inconsistent.

On the next render (e.g., the loader tick or first streaming delta), `diff_render` computes relative cursor movement as[^4]:

```elixir
line_diff = move_target - viewport_top - (hw_cursor - prev_vp_top)
```

Because `prev_vp_top` was derived from `render_end` rather than `hw_row`, this formula produces an incorrect `line_diff`. The terminal cursor ends up on the wrong row, and the subsequent `\e[2K` + content write corrupts an adjacent line — specifically the second banner hint line.

---

## What Upstream Does Differently

Upstream `tui.ts` tracks `finalCursorRow` as the actual cursor position after rendering and uses it — not `renderEnd` — when updating `previousViewportTop`[^5]:

```typescript
// tui.ts:1196
this.previousViewportTop = Math.max(prevViewportTop, finalCursorRow - height + 1);
```

`hardwareCursorRow` is also synchronously updated from `finalCursorRow` immediately before this[^6], keeping both values in lockstep.

---

## Fix

One-line change in `renderer.ex:329`:

```elixir
new_vp_top = max(prev_vp_top, hw_row - height + 1)
```

This ensures `previous_viewport_top` always reflects where the terminal cursor actually is, not where line-buffer rendering ended, so the relative cursor movement formula stays correct across frames.

---

[^1]: `position_cursor/3` — [`renderer.ex:381–394`](apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/renderer.ex#L381-394). When `cursor_seq` contains `\e[row;colH`, computes `buffer_row = viewport_top + screen_row` and returns it as `hw_row`, which may differ from the `render_end` input.

[^2]: `hardware_cursor_row` stored as `hw_row` — [`renderer.ex:334`](apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/renderer.ex#L334).

[^3]: `previous_viewport_top` uses `render_end` — [`renderer.ex:329`](apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/renderer.ex#L329). Bug site.

[^4]: Relative cursor movement formula — [`renderer.ex:305`](apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/renderer.ex#L305). Assumes `prev_vp_top` anchors the viewport at the hardware cursor row.

[^5]: Upstream `previousViewportTop` from `finalCursorRow` — [`tui.ts:1196`](tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/tui.ts#L1196).

[^6]: Upstream `hardwareCursorRow = finalCursorRow` — [`tui.ts:1192–1193`](tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/tui.ts#L1192-1193).
title: Render: banner hint line corrupted during streaming
